intended_object: The global sections functor Γ from sheaves of R-modules to types. It sends M to its type of global sections (compatible families of sections, i.e. the limit of the underlying presheaf) and acts on morphisms by applying them sectionwise. Inferred from the docstring and from its use alongside `unitHomEquiv`.
explanation: On objects, the functor gives `M.sections`, which is the sections type `M.val.sections` of the underlying presheaf of modules. On a morphism f it gives `sectionsMap f`, which is the presheaf-level map `PresheafOfModules.sectionsMap f.val`. Composition and identities are preserved by `rfl` (lemmas `sectionsMap_comp` and `sectionsMap_id`). This is the standard global sections functor to `Type`, defined for sheaves of modules over an arbitrary site and an arbitrary sheaf of rings, so it is at its natural generality. It is the sheaf-level version of the presheaf construction and is the expected companion in Mathlib's API, not an unnecessary duplicate.
